subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The implementation choice crosses a third-party persistence boundary and may require new operator configuration, schema-version handling, historical backfill rules, and live Open WebUI compatibility proof that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path using a maintainer-approved Open WebUI API or schema contract, with docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

options.title: Route to plugin/integration seam
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin or extension API is needed to support this external sync safely outside core.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add an operator-enabled sync path using a maintainer-approved Open WebUI API or schema contract, with docs, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history signal on Gateway chat/session surfaces and Open WebUI-facing docs.
